explanation: Near maximum (9-10) early in the episode (about trials 0-30) at every step, then it slowly drifts down later: D1 stays 9-10 (dropping to about 7-8 after losses near trial 90), GO falls to about 8 by trial 70 and 5-7 by trial 90. At D2 it depends on the state reached: reaching S1 after choosing a2 (rare) stays 9-10 at any time, reaching S1 after a1 (common) is a few points under GO (7 mid-episode, 4-5 late), reaching S2 after a2 (common) is 8-9 early but only 2-6 late, and reaching S2 after a1 (rare) is the lowest at 0-2 (about 4 in the first trials).
